thread:
taylor: hitting a weird case where SSE clients reconnect and the 'fallback' route gets credit for in-flight tokens. cost dashboards spike but on the runtime side no extra traffic.
mina: whoa. are those tokens from resumed streams or new connections?
diego: looks like resumed streams. sequence: client touches /sse -> gets route=primary -> connection breaks -> client reconnects with resume_id -> proxy routes to fallback pool, proxy sets header X-Route=fallback but telemetry pipeline dedupes by resume_id and merges counts into the primary labelset.
taylor: exact log sample: ``[2026-04-12T09:12:01Z] resume_id=rid-77 route=primary sent_tokens=340 tenant=shoply`` then ``[2026-04-12T09:12:05Z] resume_id=rid-77 route=fallback sent_tokens=20 tenant=shoply`` yet dashboard shows ~360 tokens under route=primary for that minute.
riley: is the dedupe logic in the exporter or in the metrics aggregator?
diego: exporter attaches labels (route, resume_id). aggregator dedupes on resume_id to avoid double counts from retries. problem: it keeps the first labelset it saw and merges subsequent label deltas into that labelset instead of attributing to the new route label. we changed that dedupe to be resume-first for idempotency, which is causing misattribution.
mina: so change was intentional to get idempotent ingestion, but side-effect is lost route signal. any quick knobs?
taylor: we could change prioritization: prefer freshest route label for a resume_id if route label differs and timestamp delta < 30s.
riley: but that risks flipping counts around during normal reconnect churn. Ops side might see oscillation.
diego: alternative: stop deduping at the aggregator for resume_id and instead dedupe at billing-join by resume_id+route. that keeps both signals but increases cardinality temporarily.
mina: how bad is cardinality? we measured resume_ids per tenant ~2/s under heavy traffic. doubling labelsets for a tenant is ok for short canary but not long-term.
taylor: mitigation plan proposal: (1) short-term: change aggregator to use 'latest-route' tie-breaker when resume-dedupe encounters route mismatch and last_seen < 20s; (2) medium-term: change billing join to dedupe by (resume_id, route) and add expired TTLs; (3) add Grafana alert: rate of resume_id route-mismatches > 10% -> paging.
riley: adding UI note too: console will display a blue banner when route-mismatch churn detected: "Some metrics may be attributed to previous route during reconnects."
diego: PR ready for the short-term tweak: https://git.redwood/repo/metrics-agg/pull/789 - it's a 7-line change. needs canary.
mina: agree to canary. what's the rollout cadence?
taylor: canary at 5% for 20m, watch billing totals and token rate differences, then 25% -> 100% if clear. deploy-bot: scheduled rollout canary-789 at 2026-04-12T15:00:00Z.
riley: also adding a temporary safe-guard in autoscaler: ignore single-window surges from a tenant with >50% resume-route mismatch flagged. this prevents noisy premature scale-ups.
diego: included unit tests for both resume-first and latest-route behaviors. also added fuzz test for out-of-order telemetry.
mina: will update private deploy changelog; customers on older releases might need patches. backport?
taylor: backport to v1.7 since some customers reported similar spikes last month. minor change.
riley: timeline: diego merges canary PR after approvals, mina creates rollback playbook and updates console copy, taylor monitors autoscaler and billing dashboards.
deploy-bot: canary-789 STARTED by diego at 2026-04-12T15:00:05Z
taylor: initial 10m look good, no new billing deltas.
mina: running a synthetic resume flood test to try to trigger mismatch, posting results in 30m.
diego: note for post-mortem: consider moving dedupe key to (tenant, resume_id, route_version) to capture route lineage and keep billing stable during policy changes.
riley: agreed. also add metric: resume_route_mismatch_total{tenant} for alerting.
taylor: thanks everyone. once canary stable we'll roll to prod and then follow up with a short post explaining why some historic billing rows may shift by a few minutes during the change.
mina: filed docs ticket for console message and support talking points: https://zube.redwood/board/streams/issue/2442
taylor: closing loop: PR merged to canary ring and monitoring enabled. will update thread after 2h.

taylor: rolling to 25% now.
